culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Wataru Furuya. Part of the lock on the trunk was fake and could be pulled out: Kasuga did not need this trick (for he knew beforehand the contents of the chest) and Taruoka did not rig the lock himself but asked Furuya to do so. It turns out the defending champion, Shuuhei Kurimura, was able to win for six weeks in a row because Wataru told him in advance what fruits were inside the chest, as the AD was rewarded for leaking out its contents.
